name: obrowse
description: oBrowse: an OpenCode v2 plugin and Chrome extension that let OpenCode drive the browser.
author: Martin Lammetun Thommesen <267603464+martinthommesen@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp types/index.d.ts types/tui.d.ts dist/ && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: esbuild extension/service-worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/extension/service-worker.js && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json', 'utf8')); manifest.version = require('./package.json').version; fs.writeFileSync('dist/extension/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.pretest: node -e "const n=require('node:fs').globSync(['src/**/*.test.ts', 'extension/**/*.test.ts']).length; if (n < 4) { console.error('expected at least 4 test files, found '+n); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (!m.default?.id) { throw new Error('dist/index.js does not export a plugin') } }); for (const file of ['./dist/tui.js', './dist/extension/manifest.json', './dist/extension/service-worker.js']) { if (!require('node:fs').existsSync(file)) { throw new Error(file + ' is missing') } }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:dist && pnpm pack --dry-run
